tips.tip0: Server-side scoring finishes in milliseconds; animation simulates a deeper scan experience.
tips.tip1: Each reason in the list maps to a scoring dimension so you can review the logic.
tips.tip2: If results miss the mark, tweak keywords or desired partner types above and run again.
tips.tip3: There is no perfect match score — it is a cold-start signal; real fit comes from conversation.
tips.tip4: Large budget gaps are down-weighted, but strong role complementarity may still surface.

loginBridge.dbHint: If the page is not signed in, confirm migrations ran and demo seed was executed (see .env.example).

loginBridge.footerNote: Merged deploy shares origin with the brand site; database is PostgreSQL (see prisma and .env.example).
